notes: The second route («قال وأخبرني ابن طاوس») repeats the shared head إبراهيم، هشام، معمر، الزهري and then diverges, the way the text does for «قال وحدثني» (rule 4, example 3). The route's first link after the head is an inference from the text's structure; the diverging link is ابن طاوس.
«قال محمود عن عبد الرزاق ونوساتها» names another transmitter for the same report and differs in wording, so it is a variant group.
The scene of Hafsa and the speech of Mu'awiya are inside the story, not routes.
